purpose: Diagnose and reduce the retained Phase 13 deviations without changing their acceptance budgets.

reference_points.published: The unchanged official PyPI 0.5.8 wheel pinned by Phase 13.
reference_points.current: The candidate source hash captured before each experiment.

two_version_order: Frozen/current isolation uses ABBA blocks, repeated for four workers each; an explicit order offset reverses the initial block.
diagnostics: Status projections are opt-in, so they do not change the workload mix of the primary gate.
case_order: Balanced forward/reverse blocks; identical registered case order and repetition counts on all versions. Every numerical return is synchronized.
compiler_cache: A new UUID directory for every worker invocation; no persisted cache reuse between runs.
primary_outputs: Complete actual public states and the unchanged status-preserving consumers. Diagnostic projections cannot replace primary workloads or invent published status outputs.
published_correctness: Unchanged Phase 13 common-field tolerances and declared semantic differences.

candidate_correctness.scope: Every actual numerical state field, returned consumer field, status and clipping leaf; exact shapes/dtypes/NaN patterns and semantic metadata.
candidate_correctness.reference_identity: Physical metadata is compared; reference identifier representations are retained separately because source-code cache provenance can change. No numerical identity check is moved into repeated state calls.

budgets: Original Phase 13 manifest remains authoritative. No budget is widened by this tooling; same-source controls against frozen Phase 13 are reported as additional evidence.
invalid_run_criteria: Source or harness changes during a worker or between controller/worker capture.
An imported package is outside its declared source directory.
Published package bytes differ from the pinned wheel.
Numerical dependencies, interpreter, device, precision or thread settings differ between workers.
A public evaluation, independent oracle, complete-array comparison or expected successful status check fails.
host_observations: Record load averages and process CPU/context information when available; retain every sample. Do not stop unrelated user processes or remove slow observations after seeing results.
cold_measurement: The unchanged first synchronized public call remains primary. Optional lower/compile/first-executable diagnostics use separate fresh workers and are never summed and relabeled as that call.
